test_title: SSC MTS Previous Year Paper (Held on: 22 July 2022 Shift 2)
subject: general
question:
Select the option that will improve the underlined part of the given sentence. In case no improvement is needed, select 'No improvement required'.

He indicated that a vigorous recovery programme was being carried out; 90,000 reminders __had been issued and thousands of summons sent.__

options.text: has been issued and thousands of summons sent
has been issued and thousands of summonses sent
had been issued and thousands of summonses were sent

solution:
The correct answer had been issued and thousands of summonses were sent.

• The option that will improve the underlined part of the given sentence is **had been issued and thousands of summonses were sent.**
